evidence_items.publisher: MIT Press; Ian Goodfellow, Yoshua Bengio and Aaron Courville
evidence_items.explanation: The account dates the retreat from the mid-1990s through 2007. It also records continued technical successes and institutional support, so it supports declining prominence rather than literal extinction.

evidence_items.locator: Page 1, statement by ACM President Cherri M. Pancake
evidence_items.explanation: ACM describes deep learning as embedded in widely used computing applications. This supports practical entrenchment, although the adoption statement is not an independently audited census.

evidence_items.locator: Satya Nadella's prepared remarks, GitHub paragraph
evidence_items.explanation: Microsoft reported substantial actual use of its AI coding product immediately before the post. Together with the earlier adoption record, this supports continuing commercial relevance.

unresolved_gaps: There is no common numerical measure comparing the durability of the two revivals.
